scope: Actual production React components with deterministic representative native fixtures. Before plugin loads exact baseline git source for all 9 domain TSX modules and relevant baseline CSS. A scene counts only after its specific heading/control/value gate passes; files and screenshots are not scene coverage units.

sources.identity: Retained official BoardUI MIT source captured 2026-11-01

named in-place progressive disclosure, real DisclosureGroup; important state remains outside
whole-row title/detail/chevron; preserve original native selection and reading
reuse actual controls; local label flex rules correct composite rows without changing shared source

sources.identity: Existing approved local Vaul 1.1.2 adaptation, package.json pinned
sources.mechanism: existing modal focus/dismissal/drag behavior retained; product-owned body scroll and confirmation footer composition only
